overview: The paper introduces TPRU, a dataset and reinforcement learning-based fine-tuning paradigm (GRPO) using targeted temporal tasks and negative sampling to significantly enhance temporal and procedural understanding in smaller Multimodal Large Language Models.

modules.name: Raw Sequence Filtering Module
modules.description: Processes raw heterogeneous data (videos, screenshots) into canonical image sequences and utilizes a large VLM to automatically filter out sequences lacking temporal coherence, visual clarity, or continuous action.

modules.name: Annotation and Negative Sampling Module
modules.description: Generates positive textual descriptions for coherent image sequences and creates hard negative samples by deliberately mismatching descriptions with visual sequences to enforce cross-modal validation.

modules.name: Task Formulation Engine
modules.description: Transforms curated image sequences and descriptions into three structured training tasks: Temporal Reordering (shuffling frames to restore order), Next-Frame Prediction (predicting the intermediate frame), and Previous-Frame Review (predicting the initial frame) with distractors.

modules.name: Multi-Image Dataset and DataLoader
modules.description: Implements a custom PyTorch dataset to handle multi-image interleaved inputs, manage task-specific prompting, tokenize vision-language pairs, and construct batches for different procedural tasks.

modules.name: Base Model Loader
modules.description: Initializes and loads the Qwen2.5-VL multimodal models of varying scales with their respective vision encoders and language model backbones for subsequent fine-tuning.

modules.name: GRPO Optimization Core
modules.description: Implements the Group-wise Preference Optimization algorithm, managing rollout generation, policy gradient calculations, and KL divergence regularization for reinforcement learning fine-tuning.

modules.name: Reward Calculation Engine
modules.description: Computes the reinforcement learning reward signals, combining a task accuracy reward (verifying correct predictions or correct rejection of negative samples) with a format compliance reward (enforcing specific answer tags).

modules.name: RL Training Loop Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the reinforcement learning training pipeline, managing epoch iteration, rollout execution, optimizer steps, gradient accumulation, and checkpoint persistence.

modules.name: TPRU-Test Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates the fine-tuned model on the manually curated TPRU-Test benchmark, calculating accuracy across the five scenarios for temporal ordering, next-frame prediction, and previous-frame review.

modules.name: External Benchmark Integrator
modules.description: Integrates with standardized evaluation frameworks (like VLMEvalKit) to assess model generalization on established multi-image benchmarks (MuirBench, LEGO-Puzzles) and general-purpose multimodal tasks (MMMU, BLINK).

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes controlled ablation experiments to analyze the impact of task composition, negative sampling, data volume, and training paradigms (SFT vs. GRPO) on procedural understanding capabilities.

modules.name: Video-LLM Baseline Comparator
modules.description: Executes evaluation scripts to compare the procedural understanding model against state-of-the-art Video-LLMs, demonstrating the distinction between general video understanding and precise procedural temporal reasoning.
